verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents API operations that return a company's full cap table and transactions in pages, including incremental changes (companyCaptable, companyTransactions), and markets "custom views and exports" for compliance reports. That gives a programmatic path to pull ownership and transaction data out. Nothing confirms a self-serve Excel/CSV export of the complete cap table and full transaction history from the app. missing for 10: explicit Excel/CSV file export of the full cap table, explicit export of the full transaction history in open formats, any-time self-serve export documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
